Keep every existing operation, task identity, business objective, scope, order, public interface, each declaration, null guard, workbook write and cleanup. Make only these internal interface/completeness corrections; do not redesign the workflow.
1. t_cookie_gate still exports differing pageFacts item schemas: initial page facts include observedConsentControls, but after-cookie page facts omit it. Make t_select_after_cookie_page_facts.resultType identical to t_select_initial_page_facts.resultType, including the observedConsentControls array with identical member types/requiredness/nullability. Both extract tasks process every source page independently with their existing each declaration. Bind/extract each alternative from its own observations; an empty consent-control array is allowed only when those controls are actually absent on that page. Do not manufacture controls, widen schemas or cast the union. Keep the direct metadata export ports.
2. Before EACH of t_select_initial_page_facts, t_select_after_cookie_page_facts, t_select_results_page_facts and t_select_product_page_facts, add an explicit requires conjunction that the associated metadata captureTruncated == false and manifestTruncated == false. Use the existing corresponding t_initial_metadata, t_after_cookie_metadata, t_results_metadata, t_product_metadata ports and retain appropriate same-scope dependencies. This must fail before mapping or interpretation on incomplete observations and retain existing cleanup. The current later conditional alone allows inference to consume incomplete data first. Preserve all other task fields and accepted requirements. No raised limits, new caller inputs, invented selectors or new permissions.
